verdict.rationale: Expensify's own 'Ask Expensify AI anything' material describes a built-in assistant that takes plain-language requests to act inside the product. It can create, categorize, tag, approve and reject expenses, configure workspaces and build rules, and produce answers and charts on account data. That is the core of delegating tasks to an in-product AI. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation beyond blog-level claims (scope, limits, confirmation/permission model), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the assistant works as described.
